title: Kablueh
description: Adds many 'splosive things to your world!, particularly launchers.
body:
Adds many 'splosive things to your minecraft world. Particularly rocket launchers.
I made this mod in MCreator during the now two-week minecraft phase im having.

Rocket launchers are the weakest, the next tier is Missile Launcher, then Torpedo Launcher.
I plan to add things such as:

Mobs

More Superweapons

Armour

Functional Blocks

and more.

(i am relatively new to modding so yeah expect some bugs or low quality things, also, again, this was made in mcreator.)
